title: eriogonum kennedyi subsp. typicum
intro: Eriogonum kennedyi subsp. typicum, commonly known as Kennedy's buckwheat or desert buckwheat, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the buckwheat family. It is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, and is known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including wound healing, fever reduction, and relief from respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum kennedyi subsp. typicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
